notes.title: New Basketball Minigame and Level Select
notes.content:
The latest update adds a new Basketball competition level to the snow region. The minigame is inspired by the old "Pop a Shot" arcade games except you have to shoot the balls with Vandozer's pistons.
A basket is worth 2 points x the ball's multiplier which increases by 1 with each shot made.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216279/97547e397f2d2b2d7ddf1455b1b43deb9b53c90d.gif

I've also added a level select option in the main menus so you can access the new minigame and the other competition levels quickly. 

Other fixes and tweaks-

 changed the first walker level's position on the map so that it is introduced sooner
 added spike grind segment to Webergin' level to teach mechanic earlier
 made ending of Boulder Balance slightly easier
 fixed glitch where gear collecting stopped
 fixed issue of Van getting stuck during Logo to Van transition warp
 changed some bullet requirements in snow region to fit in new basketball game
